about:
# SpellActivationOverlay

WoW Classic addon for displaying Spell Alerts in combat.

Inspired by Retail’s _Spell Activation Overlay_ feature, also known as _Spell Alert_.

Hosted on CurseForge https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/spellactivationoverlay

For visual previews, please visit the above CurseForge link.

releases.name: Forever Update XIII
releases.notes:
## Classes
### Mage
New Spell Alert
- Arcane Tunneling (Season of Discovery)
### Rogue
New Glowing Button
- Shank (Forever)
### Warrior
New Spell Alert
- Bloodthrill (Forever)

Updated Spell Alert
- Overpower is displayed in all stances (Forever)

Updated Glowing Button
- Overpower glows in all stances (Forever)
## Bug Fixes
### Sounds
Sounds should no longer cause issues during combat (Forever)
### Druid
The Omen of Clarity spell alert should now display correctly in Cat Form (Forever)
### Mage
Clearcasting option now longer appears twice (Era, TBC, Wrath, Cata, MoP)
### Warrior
Execute should no longer glow without a target (Forever)
## Miscellaneous
Spell alerts fade out more smoothly after leaving combat
- It was fading out from 100% to 50% in 0.2 second
- It now fades out from 100% to 60% in 3 seconds

The result is still dimming spell alerts out of combat, but with a much less brutal transition.
## Contributors
Shout-out to our amazing contributors
- Sakouzw for his patience and kindness when testing Overpower
- HugoDamore for fixing the Cat Form issue
- hatemachine222 for reporting the sound issue

Thanks!

releases.name: Forever HYPE
releases.notes:
## General
### Spell Alerts
Spell Alerts now have a countdown number, similar to the shrinking effect.
- This effect is disabled by default; enter /sao to enable or disable it
- _Visual Countdown_ rules the shrinking, formerly known as _Spell Alert Progressive Timer_
- _Text Size_ rules the new number functionality; it starts at Off (disabled) and can be increased to select the font size

Some countdown numbers are not displayed on purpose to avoid confusion.

Spell Alerts can now have a shifted position.
- Alerts can share the same location (Top/Left/Right) without overlapping
- Previously, sharing used other techniques such as scaling
- This new technique should provide richer Spell Alerts with less confusion
### User Interface
The options panel (/sao) has been slightly redesigned to make room for the new countdown number functionality.
## Classes

New Spell Alert
- Revelation weapon enchantment (Forever)
